symptom: `alter page … { insert into grp1 { … }; }` for an Accordion group named in CREATE (`group grp1 (…)`), on a page that also holds a data grid: widget "grp1" not found. DataGrid2 columns are addressed by a derived name (the bound attribute, or the caption), not the name written in MDL — available columns: Name (run DESCRIBE PAGE to confirm). The group is addressable (`acc1 item@1`), but nothing said so
cause: widgetNotFoundError's only hint for unnamed things was the DataGrid 2 column list; the object-list item address (#1453) shipped without joining the miss. CREATE accepts a name on an item and drops it (no MDL-DEPR005 for def-driven item keywords — the visitor has no widget registry), so the name-based statement is the natural next one
insight: When an address form for unnamed nodes ships, the miss message is part of it: run the reporter's own failing statement against the new build, not only the new form — every new form here worked and the original row still pointed elsewhere. The hint lists only widgets `item` can resolve (exactly one object list) and skips a list keyed `columns`, the rule findInWidgetChildren uses; a DataGrid 2 test fixture without `Type: Object, IsList: true` on its columns would not exercise that skip (gridWithCaptionColumns omits it), so the test builds the shipped shape. check -p and exec share the message, so one fix covers both. Still open: a CREATE-time warning for a name on a def-driven item, which needs the registry at check time
